description_nl: 2026-10-06: slab tax on normal income (old regime by age; new the same for all), 111A at 20% and 112A at 12.5% above 1.25 lakh, 112 at 12.5%; a resident's unused basic exemption first eats into those gains; 87A (resident, total up to 12 lakh new / 5 lakh old) - in the new regime only against normal-rate tax, with marginal relief just above 12 lakh; surcharge on the tax (special gains at most 15%) with marginal relief; 4% cess; tax rounded to the nearest 10 (288B).
